tools.name: get_domain_grade
tools.description: Passive, read-only security grade (A-F, 0-100) for a public domain, from public DNS, email authentication (SPF, DKIM, DMARC), HTTPS/TLS and HTTP response headers. It is not a penetration test, and a good grade is not a security guarantee. Rate limit: 8 calls per minute per client; identical repeat q

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_domain_grade · Public sink: get_domain_grade.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_domain_grade · Public sink: get_domain_grade

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
